name: smwmusic-x-men-vs-street-fighter-blinded-soldier-cammy-s-theme-remix
title: X-Men vs. Street Fighter - Blinded Soldier ~ Cammy's Theme (Remix)
description:
𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐦𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐞𝐧𝐣𝐨𝐲 𝐛𝐞𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐛𝐞𝐚𝐭. 𝐋𝐞𝐭 𝐦𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐨𝐝𝐞𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐟𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞.

Did a remix of Cammy White's theme from X-Men vs. Street Fighter, which is actually an arrangement of her theme from Street Fighter Alpha 2 Gold. One of the coolest songs from that game, and the only song for a returning character that wasn't an arrangement of a previous SSF2 theme.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. G Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. F# Minor (Custom Pitch)
